title: Material Handling Method Statement

4.0 Transport Procedure

PhaseRequirements
LOADING• Position equipment correctly
• Insert forks/attachment fully
• Tilt load back (forklift)
• Lift just enough to clear floor
• Check stability before moving
• Secure load if required
TRAVEL• Travel with load low (4-6" off ground)
• Observe speed limits: ______ mph
• Use designated travel lanes
• Sound horn at intersections
• Watch for pedestrians
• Avoid sudden stops/starts
• Maintain safe following distance
UNLOADING• Position accurately at destination
• Lower load slowly
• Verify stable placement
• Remove equipment carefully
• Check for tip hazards
